items.title: Billy Bauer interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, March 22, 1998
items.q: The interviewee is Billy Bauer. The person to judge is 'Bill'. The transcript contains the quote 'Lookit, Bill' spoken by Abe, addressing the interviewee (Billy Bauer). There is no mention of a separate person named 'Bill' with whom the interviewee has a relationship.

ctx.x: It doesn’t ring a bell with me.

But anyway, when Abe, on account of the Army, Abe didn’t want to take me out on the road for a ten week, you know the bands used to stay in a hotel, that was the business. Now I realize, I didn’t know it then, but they’d stay in a hotel like the Lincoln, which isn’t there anymore, and you’d do about ten weeks or three months in a hotel, and every night, or two nights a week you’d be on this radio you know. And then you’d go out and do one-nighters and colleges and things like that. So when you’d come back he…
We were talking before the cameras were rolling about one thing with Chubby Jackson. Something about he actually took you down one day, and who was the other fellow you were talking about?
